name: uncutoff
description: Stop coding agents from writing pre-cutoff legacy APIs with manifest-gated checks and self-correction hooks.

interface.longDescription: Version-gated AST and config scanner paired with an Agent Skill and lifecycle hooks that catch deprecated or removed pre-cutoff APIs across Python, Pydantic v2, FastAPI, AI SDKs, Tailwind v4, Next.js 15, React 19, and Svelte 5.
defaultPrompt: Run uncutoff detect and uncutoff scan on this repository to audit for pre-cutoff APIs
Check recent changes for Tailwind v4, Next.js 15, Pydantic v2, or retired AI SDK usage
